title: Céline Dion Paris return grosses $125m across first leg
summary: The first leg of Céline Dion’s long-awaited Paris comeback residency grossed $125.5m (€112.29m) across its 16 nights, according to Billboard Boxscore. The AEG Presents-promoted run at Plenitude Arena in Paris, Europe’s largest indoor arena, pulled in 539,000 fans, at an average of 33,688 attendees per show. The first leg of the singer’s return to live performance ended on 17 October, and the residency will recommence in May 2027 for ten further shows. title: FestIndex pledges to tackle ‘biggest festival marketing shift ever’
summary: A new social media benchmarking tool aims to help festivals address “the biggest marketing shift there has ever been in the festival industry”, its founder says. title: Finnish music rivals pop and rock listening at home, finds report
summary: Finnish-language pop is as popular as rock and English-language pop in its home market, according to a new industry report, as local language music finds growing appeal across Europe. The Music Listening in Finland report shows that the three most popular genres in Finland are tied in popularity, with 53% of the population. Finnish schlager and metal come next in popularity, each liked by 40% of the representative group, with rap/hip hop, indie rock, and K-pop growing in demand. summary: Catering specialist Eat To The Beat (ETTB) and backstage service provider Inner Sanctum have formalised a partnership to “streamline” touring services into a package deal.
